items.name: Code
items.summary: The project editor beside your chats.
items.description: A full code editor inside the Girru desktop app: open a project folder, edit its files and switch back to your chats without losing what is open.
permissions: Opens only in the Girru desktop app
Edits files in the project folder you open

items.name: GenVR
items.description: Give your agents a place to live and work: build 3D spaces, walk through them with your team and publish them when you are ready. Uses your GenVR account connection.
permissions: Publishes a space only when you choose to

items.name: Terminal
items.summary: Your shell next to your agents.
items.description: A terminal inside Girru for the owner, next to the chats and the task board. Agents never get it by adding the app.
permissions: Runs commands you type, on this computer, as you

items.name: Trading
items.summary: Practice trading with an agent team.
items.description: Practice trading with fictional money and an agent team: watch the market, test ideas on past charts and see what your agents would do. No real orders are sent.
permissions: Practice only: never sends real orders
